content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

The architecture behind crypto payment gateways for digital products allows creators to accept payments directly, minimizing reliance on centralized platforms that charge exorbitant fees. Unlike Gumroad, which takes a 10% cut on sales, NOWPayments charges only 0.5%. This significant reduction in fees means that for 100 sales of a $97 product, you would retain an extra $921 in revenue. For digital creators, this difference is not just notable; it can lead to sustainable growth and profitability. By owning the entire payment process, you gain control over your sales, customer data, and product delivery, allowing for a truly sovereign commerce experience.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure consists of several key components that work in harmony to facilitate seamless transactions. You start with a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which allows you to display your digital products online for free. The backend logic is handled by tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, enabling automation of order processing and payment verification. NOWPayments integrates directly with your setup to handle crypto transactions, providing flexibility in payment options. This architecture ensures that once a customer makes a purchase, the delivery of digital products is automated and instantaneous, streamlining the entire buying process.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where access to conventional payment systems is limited or non-existent. If you're selling ebooks, online courses, templates, or any digital asset, this system empowers you to monetize your work without the barriers imposed by traditional platforms. It caters to individuals in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and other countries facing financial isolation. By utilizing this architecture, you not only safeguard your earnings but also leverage an ecosystem that respects your sovereignty as a creator. You remain in full control, ensuring that your work reaches your audience without unnecessary fees or restrictions.
Reduce your fees from 10% to just 0.5% with NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To deploy a successful crypto payment gateway for your digital products, you will need to assemble various components: first, select your hosting platform, like GitHub Pages; second, configure backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script; third, set up order storage through Supabase or Google Sheets; fourth, utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery; and finally, integrate NOWPayments for payment processing. Each piece of this puzzle is crucial to creating a smooth user experience. When combined, they form a cohesive system that allows for immediate product delivery and secure payment verification, fundamentally changing how digital creators operate.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start leveraging this infrastructure, first, choose the Complete Builder Kit for $197, which provides you with all six blueprints and seven templates necessary for a successful deployment. Follow the included documentation to set up your hosting and backend logic. Next, configure your payment gateway through NOWPayments, ensuring you choose the right crypto networks for low fees. Finally, load your digital products, test the purchasing flow, and launch your store. Each of these steps is designed to be straightforward, allowing you to quickly establish your online presence and start selling effectively.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can utilize a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments. This solution allows you to accept cryptocurrencies directly, bypassing traditional payment platforms entirely. By setting up a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can keep more of your profits and maintain control over your sales process without the limitations imposed by conventional providers.
Automate digital product delivery for seamless customer experiences.

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, consider the Complete Builder Kit available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This all-in-one solution equips you with everything needed to establish your own crypto payment gateway and digital storefront, ensuring you are not reliant on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
Your Deployment Checklist

Begin by selecting a hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, choose your backend processing method, using either Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Set up your order storage system with Supabase or Google Sheets. Configure your digital product delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions and test your setup thoroughly before launching your store.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up a crypto payment gateway for my digital products?

To set up a crypto payment gateway, choose a hosting solution like GitHub Pages, then configure backend logic with Cloudflare Workers. Use NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency transactions and ensure your digital products are ready for delivery through services like Google Drive.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept through NOWPayments?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to offer diverse payment options to your customers. This flexibility enables you to cater to a broader audience and accommodate different preferences in digital currency.
Can I automate product delivery with this setup?

Yes, you can automate product delivery using backend logic tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Once a payment is confirmed, the system can instantly send the digital product to the customer without manual intervention.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a low transaction fee of 0.5%, significantly lower than many traditional platforms. This means more of your earnings stay in your pocket, allowing for greater profitability on each sale.
Is there a risk of platform dependency with this architecture?
No, this architecture is designed to ensure sovereignty. Once deployed, you own everything and have full control over your sales process, eliminating the risk of platform dependency.
